title: The 6 Best Vibe Coding Platforms in 2026: Tested and Ranked
summary: The best vibe coding platforms of 2026, ranked: Blink, Lovable, Bolt.new, Replit, v0, and Base44 — real screenshots, live pricing, honest tradeoffs.
body_markdown: For full-stack production apps, yes. Lovable generates excellent frontends, but the database lives in Supabase (a separate account, separate billing, separate dashboard) and auth requires additional configuration. Blink's database and auth are built in — one platform, one bill, and everything is production-grade from day one. The[Lovable alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/lovable-alternatives) article breaks this down in detail.
